paragraphs: We are a leading innovator, designer, manufacturer, and marketer of recreational powerboats sold through our three brands, MasterCraft, Crest, and Balise. As a leader in recreational marine, we strive to deliver the best on-water experience through innovative, high-quality products with a relentless focus on the consumer.

Our MasterCraft segment, which manufactures and sells premium ski/wake boats, consists of our MasterCraft brand. The MasterCraft brand was founded in 1968 and evolved over the next 55-plus years to become the most award-winning ski/wake boat manufacturer in the world. Today, MasterCraft participates in one of the highest margin producing category within the powerboat industry by manufacturing the industry's premier competitive water ski, wakeboarding, and wake surfing performance boats. We believe the MasterCraft brand is known among boating enthusiasts for high performance, premier quality, and relentless innovation. We believe that the market recognizes MasterCraft as a premier brand in the powerboat industry due to the overall superior value proposition that our boats deliver to consumers. We work tirelessly every day to maintain this iconic brand reputation.

Our Pontoon segment, which manufactures and sells pontoon boats, consists of our Crest and our Balise brands. The Pontoon segment participates in the largest unit producing category in the powerboat industry. Crest, which we acquired in October 2018, was founded in 1957 and has grown to be one of the top producers of innovative, high-quality pontoon boats ranging from 20 to 27 feet. Crest's long-standing reputation for high-quality, standard features and content, and innovation provides Crest with strong dealer and consumer bases in its core geographic markets.

Our Balise brand, an all-new, independent pontoon brand which was launched in April 2024, has been conceived with the discerning consumer in mind. With luxurious accents and appointments not typically found in pontoons, we seek to manufacture our Balise boats to the highest quality standards and to position the brand as the most luxurious pontoon on the market.
Unless the context otherwise requires, "MasterCraft" and "Pontoon," as used herein, refer to our segments as described above.

We design, manufacture, and sell premium recreational inboard ski/wake and outboard boats that we believe deliver superior performance for water skiing, wakeboarding, and wake surfing, as well as general recreational boating. In addition, we offer various accessories, including trailers and aftermarket parts.

Our MasterCraft portfolio of ProStar, XStar, X, XT, and NXT models are designed for the highest levels of performance, styling, and enjoyment for both recreational and competitive use. The ProStar, XStar and X models are geared towards the consumer seeking the most premium and highest performance boating experience that we offer, and generally command a price premium over our competitors' boats at retail prices ranging from approximately $120,000 to $500,000. The MasterCraft XT lineup is designed to offer ultimate flexibility to consumers with maximum customization and maximum performance at retail prices ranging from approximately $155,000 to $225,000. The NXT models offer the quality, performance, styling, and innovation of the MasterCraft brand to the entry-level consumer, with retail prices ranging from approximately $110,000 to $150,000.

Our Crest portfolio of pontoon boats are designed for the ultimate in comfort and recreational pleasure boating. Crest's pontoon boats are designed to offer consumers the best in luxury, style and performance without compromise across a diverse model lineup ranging in length from 20 to 27 feet. The Signature Line is home to Crest's Classic models. The Premium Line boasts the Caribbean and Upper Sun Deck models with sleek lines, available tower options, unique color combinations and top-quality construction. The Ultimate Luxury Line represents the pinnacle of lavish amenities, featuring the Continental, Continental NX, and Savannah models. This lineup anticipates every need with thoughtful options, an industry-first integrated dual windshield and premium upholstery and audio upgrades. The Electric Line harmonizes industry innovations by introducing eco-friendly pontoon boats. The Current model allows consumers to
enjoy a level of peace and relaxation with less noise and minimal emissions. Crest's retail prices range from approximately $40,000 to $300,000.

We believe our Balise portfolio of models are the most refined pontoon boats in the luxury watercraft space. With sizes ranging from 24 to 26 feet and two unique seating configurations, the Balise line is the perfect boat for the discerning consumer. Our two models, Horizon and Helix, bring unrivaled luxury to the pontoon segment. Balise retail prices range from $230,000 to $350,000.

Our products are sold through extensive networks of independent dealers domestically and internationally. We target our distribution to the market category's highest performing dealers. The majority of our MasterCraft brand dealers are exclusive to our MasterCraft product lines within the ski/wake category, highlighting the commitment of our key dealers to the MasterCraft brand. Our other brands are generally served on a nonexclusive basis by their respective dealers.

We consistently review our distribution networks to identify opportunities to expand our geographic footprint and improve our coverage of the market. We constantly monitor the health and strength of our dealers by analyzing each dealer's retail sales and inventory and have established processes to identify under-performing dealers in order to assist them in improving their performance, to allow us to switch to a more effective dealer, or to direct product to markets with the greatest retail demand. These processes also allow us to better monitor dealer inventory levels and product turns and contribute to a healthier dealer network that is better able to stock and sell our products. We believe our outstanding dealer networks and our proactive approach to dealer management allow us to distribute our products more effectively than our competitors and will help us capitalize on growth opportunities as our industry volumes continue to increase.
For fiscal 2025, the Company's top ten dealers accounted for approximately 34% of our net sales and none of our dealers individually accounted for more than 10% of our total net sales.

Domestic. As of June 30, 2025, our MasterCraft brand had a total of 82 domestic dealers across 129 locations. Our Pontoon segment had a total of 126 domestic dealers across 156 locations. We define domestic dealers as those dealers with locations inside of the United States.

headings: Risks Relating to Economic and Market Conditions
Global economic conditions, particularly in the U.S., significantly affect our industry and business, and economic decline can materially impact our financial results.
Inflation and elevated interest rates for prolonged periods could adversely affect our financial results.
Fiscal concerns and policy changes may negatively impact worldwide economic and credit conditions and adversely affect our industry, business, and financial condition.
Our variable rate indebtedness subjects us to interest rate risk, which could cause our debt service obligations to increase significantly.
An increase in energy costs may materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, and results of operations.
Fluctuations in foreign currency exchange rates could adversely affect our results.
Risks Relating to Our Business
We depend on our network of independent dealers, and our financial results could be adversely affected if we are unable to maintain effective distribution.
Our ability to adjust for demand in a rapidly changing environment may adversely affect our results of operations.
We may not be able to execute our manufacturing strategy successfully, which could cause the profitability of our products to suffer.
Adverse weather conditions and climate change events can have a negative effect on revenues.
Catastrophic events, including natural and environmental disasters, acts of terrorism, or civil unrest, could have a negative effect on our operations and financial results.
Our ability to remain competitive depends on successfully introducing new or redesigned products and services that meet consumer expectations.
Divestitures and other strategic transactions may materially and adversely affect our business or results of operations.

Our financial results may be adversely affected by our third-party suppliers' increased costs or inability to adjust for our required production levels due to changes in demand or global supply chain disruptions.

Our business and operations are dependent on the expertise of our key contributors, our successful implementation of succession plans, and our ability to attract and retain management employees and skilled labor.
We may be required to repurchase inventory of certain dealers.
Our industry is characterized by intense competition, which affects our sales and profits.
Our sales may be adversely impacted by increased consumer preference for used boats or the supply of new boats by competitors in excess of demand.
Significant product repair and/or replacement due to product warranty claims or product recalls could have a material adverse impact on our results of operations.
An inability to identify and complete targeted acquisitions, as well as an inability to timely and successfully integrate completed acquisitions, could negatively impact financial results.
Our business operations could be negatively impacted by an outage or breach of our information technology systems, network disruptions, or a cybersecurity event.

Our credit facilities contain covenants which may limit our operating flexibility; failure to comply with covenants may result in our lenders restricting or terminating our ability to borrow under such credit facilities.
Actual or potential public health emergencies, epidemics, or pandemics could have a material adverse effect on our business, results of operations, or financial condition.
Risks Relating to Intellectual Property
Our intellectual property rights may be inadequate to protect our business.
If third parties claim that we infringe on their intellectual property rights, our financial condition could be adversely affected.
Risks Relating to Our Regulatory, Accounting, Legal, and Tax Environment
International tariffs could materially and adversely affect our business and results of operations.
An impairment in the carrying value of goodwill, trade names, and other long-lived assets could negatively affect our consolidated results of operations and net worth.
Compliance with environmental, health, safety, and other regulatory requirements may increase costs and reduce demand for our products.
We manufacture and sell products that create exposure to potential claims and litigation.
The nature of our business exposes us to workers' compensation claims and other workplace liabilities.
paragraphs: Our operations and financial results are subject to certain risks and uncertainties, including those described below, which could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flows, and the trading price of our common stock.

In times of economic uncertainty or recession, consumers tend to have less discretionary income and to defer significant spending on non-essential items, which may adversely affect our financial performance. The economic uncertainty caused by (i) general economic conditions, (ii) the impact of inflation and elevated interest rates, (iii) labor shortages, (iv) supply chain disruptions, (v) rapid changes in trade policy and new or increased tariffs, (vi) political uncertainty and regional or global conflicts (vii) public health crises, pandemics, or national emergencies and (viii) actions and stimulus measures adopted by local, state and federal governments may lead to unfavorable business outcomes. We continue to develop our portfolio of brands, but our business remains cyclical and sensitive to consumer spending on new boats.

Deterioration in general economic conditions that in turn diminishes consumer confidence or discretionary income may reduce our sales, or we may decide to lower pricing for our products, which could adversely affect our financial results, including increasing the potential for future impairment charges. Further, our products are recreational, and consumers' limited discretionary income in times of economic hardship may be diverted to other activities that occupy their time, such as other forms of recreational, religious, cultural, or community activities. In addition, economic uncertainty may also increase certain costs of operation, such as financing costs, energy costs and insurance premiums, which in turn may impact our results of operations. We cannot predict the strength of global economies or the timing of economic recovery, either globally or in the specific markets in which we compete.

The market prices of certain materials and components used in manufacturing our products, especially resins that are made with hydrocarbon feedstocks, fiberglass, aluminum, lumber, and steel, can be volatile. Significant increases in inflation, particularly those related to wages and increases in the cost of raw materials, have, and may continue to have, an adverse impact on our business, financial condition, and results of operations. Although inflation has moderated slightly recently, it has remained persistent in the United States and globally in recent years due in part to global supply chain issues and elevated energy prices, among other factors.

In addition, the existence of inflation in certain economies has resulted in, and may continue to result in, elevated interest rates. For examples, while the U.S. Federal Reserve cut the federal funds rate three times in 2024 by a total of 100 basis points, the U.S. Federal Reserve has held rates steady following since its January 2025 meeting. As a result, it remains to be seen whether interest rates will stabilize, increase or decrease, either globally or in the United States specifically. Inflation, along with elevated interest rates, could translate into an increased cost of boat ownership for new boat buyers, who often finance their purchases. Should inflation continue to occur and interest rates remain elevated, prospective consumers may choose to forego or delay their purchases or buy a less expensive boat in the event credit is not available to finance their boat purchases.

Elevated interest rates for prolonged periods could also incentivize dealers to reduce their inventory levels in order to reduce their interest exposure. In an effort to offset the increased interest exposure, we have offered and expect to continue offering dealer incentives to pass through the additional dealer costs to us, which in turn negatively impacts our margins.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis should be read together with the sections entitled "Risk Factors" and the financial statements and the accompanying notes included elsewhere in this Form 10-K. In addition, the statements in this discussion and analysis regarding the performance expectations of our business, anticipated financial results, liquidity and the other non-historical statements are forward-looking statements. These forward-looking statements are subject to numerous risks and uncertainties, including, but not limited to, the risks and uncertainties described in "Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements" and in "Risk Factors" above. Our actual results may differ materially from those contained in or implied by any forward-looking statements.

This section generally discusses 2025 and 2024 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2025 and 2024. Discussions of 2023 items and year-to-year comparisons between 2024 and 2023 are not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and can be found in Item 7 of the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended June 30, 2024, which was filed with the SEC on August 30, 2024.

From time to time we use certain key performance measures in evaluating our business and results of operations and we may refer to one or more of these key performance measures in this "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." These key performance measures include:
• Unit sales volume — We define unit sales volume as the number of our boats sold to our dealers during a period.
• Net sales per unit — We define net sales per unit as net sales divided by unit sales volume.
• Gross margin — We define gross margin as gross profit divided by net sales, expressed as a percentage.
• Net income margin — We define net income margin as income from continuing operations divided by net sales, expressed as a percentage.

• Adjusted EBITDA — We define Adjusted EBITDA as income from continuing operations, before interest, income taxes, depreciation, and amortization ("EBITDA"), as further adjusted to eliminate certain non-cash charges and unusual items that we do not consider to be indicative of our core/ongoing operations. For a reconciliation of EBITDA to Adjusted EBITDA, see "Non-GAAP Measures" below.

• Adjusted EBITDA margin — We define Adjusted EBITDA margin as Adjusted EBITDA divided by net sales, expressed as a percentage. For a reconciliation of Adjusted EBITDA margin to net income margin, see "Non-GAAP Measures" below.

• Adjusted Net Income — We define Adjusted Net Income as income from continuing operations, adjusted to eliminate certain non-cash charges and other items that we do not consider to be indicative of our core/ongoing operations and adjusted for the impact to income tax expense related to non-GAAP adjustments. For a reconciliation of income from continuing operations to Adjusted Net Income, see "Non-GAAP Measures" below.

• Free cash flow — We define Free cash flow from continuing operations as net cash from operating activities less purchases of property, plant, and equipment. For a reconciliation of net cash provided by operating activities of continuing operations to Free cash flow, see "Non-GAAP Measures" below.

On October 18, 2024, the Company completed the Aviara Transaction and on December 23, 2024, the Company completed the Aviara Facility Sale. In fiscal 2023, the Company sold its NauticStar business. The Company's results for all periods presented, as discussed in Management's Discussion and Analysis, are presented on a continuing operations basis. Results related to our Aviara and NauticStar reporting units are reported as discontinued operations for all periods presented. See Notes 1 and 3 in Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements for more information on discontinued operations.

On April 7, 2025 Timothy M. Oxley, Chief Financial Officer ("CFO") of the Company, announced his retirement from the Company, effective December 31, 2025. Prior to his retirement, Mr. Oxley stepped down as CFO, effective June 30, 2025, at which time, Mr. Oxley began serving as a Special Advisor. Scott Kent, Vice President of Finance, succeeded Mr. Oxley as CFO, effective July 1, 2025.

The recently imposed U.S. tariffs did not materially impact our fiscal 2025 results, but their effects and the potential imposition of modified or additional tariffs may, among other things, create new trade barriers that disrupt supply chains, raise costs, weaken consumer confidence and impact consumer demand for our products, and impact our ability to export our products, all of which could have an adverse effect on our business and financial results. The extent of the impact of tariffs on the Company's business is highly uncertain and difficult to predict. We are closely monitoring the rapidly evolving tariff landscape and are working diligently with key suppliers to mitigate risks. For additional information regarding the potential impacts of tariffs on our business and results of operations, see Item 1A "Risk Factors — Risks Relating to Our Regulatory, Accounting, Legal, and Tax Environment."

paragraphs: 本公司為水上休閒摩托艇的主要創新者、設計者、製造者與行銷者，產品透過我們三個品牌MasterCraft、Crest與Balise銷售。作為水上休閒產業的領導者，我們致力於透過創新且高品質的產品，提供最佳的水上體驗，並持續聚焦於消費者需求。

MasterCraft應報告分部製造與銷售高階的水 ski/wake 摩托艇，包含MasterCraft品牌。MasterCraft品牌於1968年成立，經過接下來55年以上的發展，成為全球最獲獎的水 ski/wake 摩托艇製造商。目前，MasterCraft參與水上摩托艇產業中毛利率最高的製造類別，製造產業中首屈一指的競技水 ski、wakeboarding與wake surfing性能摩托艇。我們相信MasterCraft品牌在休閒摩托艇愛好者中，以高性能、首屈一指的品質與持續創新而聞名。我們相信市場認可MasterCraft為水上摩托艇產業中的首屈一指品牌，這是因為我們摩托艇所提供的總體優越價值主張。我們每天努力維持這個經典品牌的聲譽。

Pontoon應報告分部製造與銷售Pontoon摩托艇，包含Crest與Balise品牌。Pontoon應報告分部參與水上摩托艇產業中最大的單元製造類別。Crest品牌我們於2018年10月取得，於1957年成立，已成長為創新且高品質Pontoon摩托艇的主要製造商，產品長度從20到27英尺不等。Crest長期以來以高品質、標準功能與內容以及創新聞名，為其核心地理市場的經銷商與消費者建立強大的基礎。
Balise品牌為全新、獨立的Pontoon品牌，於2024年4月推出，專為精明消費者設計。透過通常不見於Pontoon摩托艇的奢華裝飾與細節，我們致力於製造最高品質的Balise摩托艇，並將品牌定位為市場上最奢華的Pontoon摩托艇。
除非文意另有明確說明，本文中所稱"MasterCraft"與"Pontoon"，均指上述所描述的應報告分部。
我們設計、製造與銷售高階的休閒內燃機水 ski/wake 與外燃機摩托艇，我們相信這些摩托艇能提供水 ski、wakeboarding與wake surfing以及一般休閒摩托艇的卓越性能。此外，我們也提供各種配件，包括拖車與後市場零件。

本公司 MasterCraft 系列的 ProStar、XStar、X、XT 與 NXT 型號，設計用以提供最高階的性能、外觀與樂趣，適用於休閒與競技用途。ProStar、XStar 與 X 型號針對追求本公司所提供最 premium 且最高性能船隻體驗的消費者，其零售價格通常較競爭對手的船隻高出，價格範圍約為 120,000 美元至 500,000 美元。MasterCraft XT 系列設計用以提供消費者最大彈性，具備最高程度的客製化與性能，零售價格範圍約為 155,000 美元至 225,000 美元。NXT 型號則為 entry-level 消費者提供 MasterCraft 品牌的品質、性能、外觀與創新，零售價格範圍約為 110,000 美元至 150,000 美元。

我們Crest品牌的Pontoon摩托艇設計用以提供極致的舒適與休閒摩托艇體驗。Crest的Pontoon摩托艇設計用以提供消費者最佳的豪華、風格與性能，不計任何妥協，產品線長度從20到27英尺不等。Signature Line包含Crest的Classic系列。Premium Line則擁有Caribbean與Upper Sun Deck系列，線條流暢，可選塔樓配置，獨特色彩組合與頂級建造品質。Ultimate Luxury Line代表奢華設施的巔峯，包含Continental、Continental NX與Savannah系列。此產品線預見所有需求，提供周到的選擇，產業首創的雙風shield整合設計與頂級皮革與音響升級。Electric Line融合產業創新，推出環保型Pontoon摩托艇。Current系列讓消費者能夠
享受較低噪音與極小排放的平靜與放鬆。Crest 的零售價格範圍約為 40,000 美元至 300,000 美元。
我們相信 Balise 的產品線是豪華水上運動用品領域中最精緻的 pontoon 船隻。尺寸從 24 到 26 英尺不等，並有兩種獨特的座位配置，Balise 系列是為精明消費者打造的完美船隻。我們的兩款產品 Horizon 與 Helix，為 pontoon 系列帶來無與倫比的豪華體驗。Balise 的零售價格範圍為 230,000 美元至 350,000 美元。
我們的產品透過廣泛的獨立經銷商網路在國內與國際市場銷售。我們針對市場類別中表現最佳的經銷商進行通路佈局。我們 MasterCraft 品牌的經銷商大多專注於 MasterCraft 產品線，這突顯了我們關鍵經銷商對 MasterCraft 品牌的承諾。我們的其他品牌則通常由其對應經銷商以非獨家方式銷售。

我們持續審視通路網路，以尋找擴展地理足跡與提升市場覆蓋率的機會。我們不斷監測經銷商的營運狀況與實力，透過分析各經銷商的零售銷售額與存貨情況，並建立流程以識別表現不佳的經銷商，以協助其改善表現、轉換為更有效的經銷商，或將產品導向零售需求最高的市場。這些流程也使我們能更有效地監測經銷商存貨水準與產品週轉率，並有助於建立更健康的經銷商網路，使其更能進貨與銷售我們的產品。我們相信我們優秀的經銷商網路與積極的經銷商管理方式，使我們能比競爭對手更有效地進行產品銷售，並有助於我們把握產業營收持續成長的成長機會。
2025 年會計年度，本公司前十大經銷商佔我們淨銷售額約 34%，且無任何單一經銷商 individually 佔我們總淨銷售額超過 10%。
國內。截至 2025 年 6 月 30 日，我們 MasterCraft 品牌在美國境內共有 82 家經銷商，總共 129 個據點。我們 Pontoon 系列共有 126 家國內經銷商，總共 156 個據點。我們將位於美國境內的經銷商定義為國內經銷商。

paragraphs: 以下討論與分析應與本表單 10-K 中標題為 "風險因素" 之節、財務報表及附註等其他部分一併閱讀。此外，本討論與分析中關於我們業務之績效預期、預期財務結果、流動性及其他非歷史性陳述之語句，均屬展望性陳述。這些展望性陳述受多種風險與不確定性影響，包括但不限於 "展望性陳述警示說明" 及 "風險因素" 中所描述之風險與不確定性。我們實際結果可能與任何展望性陳述中所載或暗示之內容有重大差異。
本節一般討論 2025 年及 2024 年項目，以及 2025 年與 2024 年之間的年對年比較。關於 2023 年項目及 2024 年與 2023 年之間的年對年比較之討論，並未包含於本年度報表表單 10-K 中，可於本公司 2024 年度報表表單 10-K 中的項目 7 找到，該年度報表於 2024 年 8 月 30 日向 SEC 提交。
我們偶爾會使用某些關鍵績效指標來評估我們的業務與營運結果，並可能在本 "管理層討論與分析財務狀況與營運結果" 中提及其中一項或多項關鍵績效指標。這些關鍵績效指標包括：
• 單位銷售量 — 我們將單位銷售量定義為在一段期間內我們銷售給經銷商之船隻數量。
• 每單位淨銷售額 — 我們將每單位淨銷售額定義為淨銷售額除以單位銷售量。
• 毛利率 — 我們將毛利率定義為毛利除以淨銷售額，以百分比表示。
• 網路收入邊際 — 我們將網路收入邊際定義為持續經營業務所產生之收入除以淨銷售額，以百分比表示。
• 調整後 EBITDA — 我們將調整後 EBITDA 定義為扣除利息、所得稅、折舊及攤銷後之持續經營業務所產生之收入（"EBITDA"），並進一步調整以消除某些非現金費用及不尋常項目，這些項目我們認為並不能反映我們核心/持續經營業務之表現。有關 EBITDA 與調整後 EBITDA 之轉換關係，請參閱下方 "非 GAAP 計量指標" 部分。
• 調整後營業現金流量邊際率 — 我們將調整後營業現金流量邊際率定義為調整後營業現金流量除以淨銷售額，以百分比表示。有關調整後營業現金流量邊際率與淨收入邊際率的對應關係，請參閱下方「非GAAP指標」部分。
• 調整後淨收入 — 我們將調整後淨收入定義為持續經營業務所產生的收入，經調整以消除某些非現金費用及其他我們認為不反映本公司核心/持續經營業務的項目，並經調整與非GAAP調整相關的所得稅費用影響。有關持續經營業務所產生收入與調整後淨收入的對應關係，請參閱下方「非GAAP指標」部分。
• 自由現金流 — 我們將持續經營業務所產生的自由現金流定義為營運活動所產生的淨現金流量減去財產、廠房及設備的購置金額。有關持續經營業務營運活動所產生淨現金流量與自由現金流的對應關係，請參閱下方「非GAAP指標」部分。

於2024年10月18日，本公司完成Aviara交易，並於2024年12月23日完成Aviara融資出售。在財務年度2023年，本公司出售其NauticStar業務。本公司所有呈列期間的財務結果，如管理層討論與分析中所述，均以持續經營業務為基礎呈列。與Aviara及NauticStar應報告分部相關的結果，於所有呈列期間均列為已終止營運業務。有關已終止營運業務的更多資訊，請參閱財務會計彙編附註第1及第3項附註。
於2025年4月7日，本公司財務長Timothy M. Oxley宣佈將於2025年12月31日自本公司退休。在退休前，Mr. Oxley於2025年6月30日卸任財務長職務，此時Mr. Oxley開始擔任特別顧問。Scott Kent，財務副總裁，於2025年7月1日接任Mr. Oxley為財務長。

最近實施的美國關稅未對本公司財務年度2025的結果造成重大影響，但其影響及可能實施修改或額外關稅的潛在影響，可能導致新的貿易壁壘，幹擾供應鏈，提高成本，削弱消費者信心，並影響消費者對本公司產品的需求，同時影響本公司出口產品的能力，所有這些都可能對本公司業務及財務結果產生不利影響。關稅對本公司業務的影響程度極其不確定且難以預測。本公司密切關注快速變化的關稅環境，並與關鍵供應商密切合作以降低風險。有關關稅對本公司業務及營運結果潛在影響的更多資訊，請參閱項目1A「風險因素 — 與本公司監管、會計、法律及稅務環境相關的風險。」

headings: 與經濟及市場條件相關的風險
全球經濟條件，特別是在美國，會顯著影響我們的產業與業務，經濟衰退可能對我們的財務結果造成重大影響。
通貨膨脹及利率持續處於高位，可能會對我們的財務結果產生不利影響。
財政擔憂及政策變動可能對全球經濟與信用條件造成負面影響，並對我們的產業、業務與財務狀況產生不利影響。
我們的浮動利率債務使我們面臨利率風險，這可能會導致我們的債務償還義務大幅增加。
能源成本的增加可能對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大不利影響。
外幣交換率的波動可能對我們的結果產生不利影響。
與我們的業務相關的風險
本公司依賴獨立經銷商網路，若無法維持有效的通路，財務結果可能受到不利影響。
本公司在快速變動的環境中調整需求的能力，可能對營運結果產生不利影響。
本公司可能無法成功執行製造策略，這可能會導致產品獲利能力受損。
惡劣天氣條件及氣候變遷事件可能對收入產生負面影響。
重大事件，包括自然及環境災難、恐怖攻擊或民變，可能對本公司營運及財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司維持競爭力的能力，取決於成功推出符合消費者期待的新產品或重新設計的產品與服務。
資產處置及其他戰略交易，可能對本公司業務或營運結果產生重大且不利的影響。
本公司財務結果可能因第三方供應商成本增加或無法因應本公司所需生產量而受到不利影響，此情況可能因需求變動或全球供應鏈中斷所致。
本公司之業務及營運依賴關鍵人才之專業知識、成功執行繼任計畫，以及吸引並留住管理階層員工及技術性勞工之能力。
本公司可能需回購某些經銷商之存貨。
本公司所屬產業具有激烈競爭特性，此情形可能影響本公司之銷售與獲利。
本公司之銷售可能因消費者偏好二手船增加，或競爭對手所提供之新船供應量超過需求而受到負面影響。
因產品保固聲請或產品回收而產生之重大產品維修及/或更換，可能對本公司營運成果產生重大負面影響。
無法識別並完成目標併購，以及無法及時且成功整合已完成之併購，可能對財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司之營運可能因資訊科技系統中斷或遭入侵、網路中斷，或發生網路安全事件而受到負面影響。
本公司之信貸融資協議包含約束條款，可能限制本公司之營運彈性；未能遵守約束條款，可能導致貸款機構限制或終止本公司依該信貸融資協議借款之能力。
實際或潛在的公共衛生危機、疫情或大流行病可能對本公司業務、營運結果或財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
與智慧財產權相關的風險
本公司智慧財產權權利可能不足以保護本公司業務。
若第三方聲稱本公司侵權其智慧財產權權利，可能對本公司財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
與本公司監管、會計、法律及稅務環境相關的風險
國際關稅可能對本公司業務及營運結果造成重大且不利的影響。
商譽、商標及其他長壽命資產的攜帶價值減損，可能對本公司合併營運結果及淨資產造成負面影響。
符合環境、健康、安全及其他監管要求，可能增加成本並降低本公司產品的需求。
我們從事的業務涉及製造與銷售產品，可能導致面臨潛在索賠與訴訟風險。
我們業務的性質使我們面臨勞工補償索賠及其他工作場所責任的風險。
paragraphs: 本公司之營運及財務表現受某些風險與不確定性影響，包括下列所描述之風險，這些風險可能對本公司之業務、財務狀況、營運成果、現金流及普通股之交易價格造成不利影響。

在經濟不確定或經濟衰退時期，消費者傾向減少可自由支配所得，並延後對非必要商品之重大支出，這可能對本公司之財務表現造成不利影響。由（i）總體經濟狀況、（ii）通貨膨脹與高利率之影響、（iii）勞動力短缺、（iv）供應鏈中斷、（v）貿易政策快速變動與新或提高之關稅、（vi）政治不確定性與區域或全球衝突、（vii）公共衛生危機、疫情或國家緊急事件、（viii）地方政府、州政府及聯邦政府所採用之措施所引發之經濟不確定性，可能導致不利之商業結果。本公司持續發展品牌組合，但本公司之業務仍具週期性，並對消費者對新船之支出敏感。

總體經濟狀況惡化，進而降低消費者信心或可自由支配所得，可能導致本公司銷售減少，或本公司可能決定降低產品價格，這可能對本公司之財務結果造成不利影響，包括增加未來減損費用之潛在可能性。此外，本公司之產品屬休閒用途，消費者在經濟困難時期之可自由支配所得可能被轉移至其他活動，例如其他形式之休閒、宗教、文化或社區活動。此外，經濟不確定性也可能提高某些營運成本，例如融資成本、能源成本與保險 premiums，進而影響本公司之營運成果。本公司無法預測全球經濟之強度或經濟復甦之時間，無論是全球範圍或本公司所競爭之特定市場。
製造本公司產品所使用之某些材料與零組件之市場價格可能波動，特別是那些以石化原料製造之樹脂、纏綿布、鋁、木材與鋼鐵。通貨膨脹顯著增加，尤其是與工資及原材料成本增加相關之通貨膨脹，已對本公司之業務、財務狀況與營運成果造成不利影響，且可能持續造成不利影響。儘管近期通貨膨脹略有緩和，但由於全球供應鏈問題與高能源價格等因素，美國與全球之通貨膨脹在近年仍持續存在。

此外，某些經濟體之通貨膨脹已導致，且可能持續導致高利率。例如，雖然美國聯邦準備理事會在 2024 年已將聯邦基金利率調降三次，總計 100 基準點，但美國聯邦準備理事會在 2025 年 1 月會議後維持利率不變。因此，尚無法預測利率是否會穩定、增加或減少，無論是全球範圍或美國特定情況。通貨膨脹與高利率可能導致新船買家之船隻擁有成本增加，而新船買家通常會以貸款方式購買新船。若通貨膨脹持續發生且利率維持高水準，預期消費者可能選擇放棄或延後購買，或在無法取得貸款以購買新船時，選擇購買較便宜之船隻。
長時間高利率也可能促使經銷商減少庫存以降低其利率風險。為抵銷增加之利率風險，本公司已提供並預期將持續提供經銷商激勵措施，以將額外之經銷商成本轉嫁給本公司，這進而對本公司之毛利率造成負面影響。
